title: 13 Best Herbal Essential Oils For Itchy Skin
intro: Herbal essential oils for itchy skin are highly concentrated plant extracts used to alleviate and soothe itchy skin conditions. These oils have numerous benefits, including reducing inflammation, calming the skin, and providing antimicrobial properties to combat infections that may be causing the itchiness. Examples of herbal essential oils that can be used to treat itchy skin include tea tree oil, which has antibacterial properties to combat fungal infections, lavender oil, which has anti-inflammatory properties to soothe irritated skin, chamomile oil, which has antiseptic properties to calm and reduce redness, peppermint oil, which has cooling properties to relieve itching and itching sensation, and geranium oil, which has antiseptic and anti-inflammatory properties to balance hormones and reduce skin irritation. By incorporating these oils into a skincare routine, individuals can find natural relief from itchy skin and promote overall skin health.

preparations.preparation_desc: Calendula officinalis essential oils have been traditionally used to treat itchy skin ailments due to their anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and soothing properties. The bioactive constituents present in Calendula officinalis, such as triterpenoid saponins and flavonoids, help to reduce inflammation, promote wound healing, and provide relief from itching and irritation. By reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing, Calendula officinalis essential oils help to alleviate itchy skin symptoms, thereby providing relief from discomfort and promoting overall skin health. The benefits of using Calendula officinalis essential oils for itchy skin include reduced inflammation, improved wound healing, and a decrease in the intensity and frequency of itchy skin episodes.
preparations.preparation_study: According to "Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology", Calendula officinalis essential oils, when combined in a three-herbs formula with Cortex Moutan and Herba Menthae, have shown anti-inflammatory effects, reduced skin inflammation, and promoted wound healing, which may help alleviate itchy skin associated with atopic dermatitis.

preparations.preparation_desc: Aloe barbadensis essential oils have been traditionally used to treat itchy skin ailments due to their anti-inflammatory, soothing, and moisturizing properties. The bioactive constituents of Aloe barbadensis, including aloin, aloe-emodin, and vitamin E, help to reduce inflammation, calm irritation, and promote skin hydration, thereby alleviating itchy skin conditions. The essential oils extracted from the Aloe barbadensis plant have been found to be effective in treating eczema, dermatitis, and other skin irritations by reducing redness, itching, and swelling, and promoting skin healing. The benefits of using Aloe barbadensis essential oils to treat itchy skin ailments include rapid relief from itching, reduced inflammation, and improved skin health, making it a popular natural remedy for skin issues.
preparations.preparation_study: According to "Infectious disorders drug targets", Aloe barbadensis essential oils for itchy skin have been recognized for their therapeutic properties, as part of the herbal resources that are potent and safe in the treatment of dermatological infections.

preparations.preparation_desc: Lavandula angustifolia essential oils have been traditionally used to treat itchy skin ailments due to their anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antipruritic properties. The bioactive constituents, including linalool and linalyl acetate, help to soothe and calm the skin, reducing itching and inflammation. By reducing redness and irritation, Lavandula angustifolia essential oils assist in relieving the discomfort associated with itchy skin conditions, promoting a sense of relaxation and well-being. Regular use of this herbal preparation can also help to prevent future breakouts and promote healthy skin, making it a popular natural remedy for itchy skin ailments.
preparations.preparation_study: According to "Journal of ethnopharmacology", Lavandula angustifolia essential oils, specifically its major components linalool and linalyl acetate, have shown effectiveness in providing relief from itchy skin associated with psoriasis-like skin inflammation, resulting in 73.67% recovery in psoriasis area severity index scores and significant reduction in Th-17 cell-specific cytokines.

preparations.preparation_desc: Melaleuca alternifolia essential oils, also known as tea tree oil, have been traditionally used to treat itchy skin ailments due to their antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of tea tree oil, including cineole, limonene, and terpinen-4-ol, help to reduce inflammation and combat fungal and bacterial infections that can cause itchy skin. By using tea tree oil topically, it helps to soothe and calm the affected skin, providing relief from itching and discomfort. The benefits of using tea tree oil to treat itchy skin include its ability to promote healing, reduce inflammation, and prevent infection, making it a popular natural remedy for skin issues.
preparations.preparation_study: According to "Adverse drug reactions and toxicological reviews", Melaleuca alternifolia essential oils for itchy skin have antifungal, antiviral, antibacterial and acaricidal activity, which makes them effective against skin infections such as scabies.

preparations.preparation_desc: Urtica dioica essential oils have been traditionally used to treat itchy skin ailments due to their anti-inflammatory, antihistaminic, and analgesic properties, which help to alleviate itching, reduce redness, and soothe irritated skin. This herbal preparation works by inhibiting the release of histamine, a chemical responsible for itching and inflammation, allowing for relief from uncomfortable symptoms. The bioactive constituents of Urtica dioica essential oils, including caffeic acid, ferulic acid, and quercetin, have been found to contribute to its therapeutic effects, providing antioxidant and anti-inflammatory benefits that help to calm and comfort the skin. Regular use of Urtica dioica essential oils can provide long-lasting relief from itchy skin ailments, promoting a sense of comfort and well-being, making it a popular natural remedy for skin irritations.
preparations.preparation_study: According to "Journal of pharmacy & bioallied sciences", Urtica dioica essential oils have shown anti-inflammatory and antihistaminic effects, which may help to alleviate itchy skin.
